points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B for healthcare document intelligence, improving clinical finding extraction accuracy by ~20% and enabling reliable automation of administrative clinical practices.

\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings with BM25 search for structured and unstructured healthcare data, enhancing relevance and coverage for production clinical ML models at scale.

\item Developed LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline with rigorous experimental design to assess model faithfulness, clinical accuracy, and performance across hundreds of healthcare QA examples, ensuring production-ready reliability and scientific best practices.

\item Optimized and deployed clinical ML/LLM systems using batched inference, context engineering, and anomaly detection for data validation, reducing processing time by ~80% and data quality issues by 25% while maintaining model accuracy.

\item Fine-tuned and productionized Llama-3.1-8B using QLoRA (4-bit) on clinical data, gaining hands-on experience in parameter-efficient LLM training and scalable healthcare deployment through cross-functional collaboration.
